source.notes: Recordings made inside temples by a former member and posted online. They were circulating and being discussed by 27 January 2017. The original uploads, their dates and the ordinances each one covers are not yet identified; archive copies and file hashes are needed.

source.notes: Published under a Creative Commons licence. The elders' handbook and related letters were in evidence; the report quotes and summarises them. Exhibits for the case are listed at https://www.childabuseroyalcommission.gov.au/exhibits-case-study-29.
